To upload your own apple sprite, copy any png image into the 'Apple sprites' folder and select it using the ingame menu.

To upload your own snake sprites, copy a folder into 'Snake sprites' containing png images of the same dimensions, named the following:
'Up.png' , 'Down.png', 'Left.png', 'Right.png', 'Body.png'

These images should represent the snake head pointing up, down, left, and right, alongside one for the rest of its body.
You can then select a folder containing a set of pngs formatted in this way using the ingame dialogue.

If you are playing the Godot version only, you can alternatively upload custom sprites formatted in the following manner:

Copy a folder into 'Snake sprites' containing square png images of the same dimensions facing the up direction, named the following:
'Body.png' 'Up.png'

This subfolder of 'Snake sprites' can then be selected using the ingame dialogue to use the sprites.
Note that body sprites changing direction is currently only supported in the Godot version of the game.
